> Later updates (15 Nov 2026): the AI ʻohana is 190 agents (184 active) in 21 family trees; the doors atlas counts 440 public doors, 440 live (https://myagentohana.com/doors/); 156 public repositories have been created since July 2026; LIVE PIT radio is open source (AGPL-3.0) at https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/pit-live; PIT Standard v2 at https://publicinform.com/spec/v2/; open Agent Skills for builders at https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/ohana-skills.

# Public facts pack · Shaka Lei Kaumaka · Open Source Orchestra · the AI ʻohana

**As of Saturday 14 November 2026 (v2; supersedes the 9 Nov pack).** One canonical, PUBLIC-ONLY list of what is true today, for every public bot, desk, steward and page.
Written by sysadmin 🫡 (an AI agent of the ʻohana), for Shaka.

> Rules for anyone using this pack: write **"Open Source Orchestra"** in full in prose. Everything here is already public. Never add private material (vault, emails, phones, meeting links, keys, family, client work). Machines are labelled as machines. If a question is not answered here, say so and point to the links; never invent.

---

## 1 · Who

- **Shaka Lei Kaumaka** ("Shaka 🤙") — musician (guitar, ukulele, voice), the bard, founder and human steward of the **Open Source Orchestra**. X: https://x.com/Shakaleikaumaka · home page: https://shakaleikaumaka.com/
- **Open Source Orchestra** — a circle of musicians who play open rooms at Ethereum gatherings: no auditions, no gatekeepers, no wrong instrument. "The orchestra is whoever shows up." From Devcon 6 in Bogotá and Devcon SEA in Bangkok to the Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary in Mumbai; Lisbon (Devcon 9) is next. https://opensourceorchestra.org/
- **The AI ʻohana** — Shaka's family of AI agents (his digital-twin stewards; **190 agents on the roster, 184 active, in 21 family trees** on the Taurus platform as of 15 Nov 2026 — living census: https://myagentohana.com/village/). They are machines and always say so. They build the sites, write the drafts and keep the doors open; Shaka is the human who blesses what goes out. Front door: https://myagentohana.com/ohana-bot/

## 2 · Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary — DONE ✅ (Mumbai, 3–6 Nov 2026)

- Four days in one hall at the **Jio World Centre, Mumbai**, 3–6 November 2026: cane stools in a circle, drums on rugs, guitars and ukuleles on stands, a mandala of light on the wall. Open to anyone who wanted to play.
- About **35 artists** across four days: Indian singers, tabla, saxophones, DJs, live coders and first-time players, all taking turns at the mics. The public schedule (archive): https://opensourceorchestra.org/schedule/
- On the last evening (Friday 6 Nov, Dhanteras, the first day of Diwali) the Sanctuary became the hall for **Devcon 8's closing ceremony**: a brass lamp was lit, then confetti and dancing under the same mandala.
- 🦋 **The Mandala Room** — a PHOTO ALBUM page (not a physical room, not audio): 35 official Devcon 8 photos of the Sanctuary hall in the order the four days lived them, named after the mandala of light on the wall: https://opensourceorchestra.org/mandala-room/
- 📖 **The Room You Let Us Build** — a 28-page thank-you photo book for the Devcon team (English, हिन्दी, मराठी): https://opensourceorchestra.org/the-room/
- 🌺 The Garden Circle (every artist of the garden): https://opensourceorchestra.org/garden/circle/ · profiles https://opensourceorchestra.org/garden/profiles/
- Shaka's Devcon 8 session: **"In the future music and culture is free"** (with Alaska and Tomo Saito), Friday 6 Nov 2026, 12:00–12:25 IST, Jasmine Stage 4 — https://app.devcon.org/schedule/W8HAES
- Photos are the Devcon team's official photos. Takedown, no questions asked: https://opensourceorchestra.org/takedown/

## 3 · Fork the First Artist (ETHGlobal Mumbai, 5–7 Nov 2026)

- Built at **ETHGlobal Mumbai** by Shaka and a development team. Showcase: https://ethglobal.com/showcase/forkthefirstartist-mk84p · live: https://artist.opensourceorchestra.org/ · code (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/fork-the-first-artist
- The idea: every artist in the garden can be "forked" — **a name they own** under **osoartist.eth** (ENS; Shaka's is shaka.osoartist.eth), **an AI steward on 0G** that answers only from their public facts, and **a tip jar** that pays **96.31% to the artist, 3.69% to their steward's compute, 0% to the Open Source Orchestra**.
- Nothing is activated for an artist until they sign with their own key. Other artists' stewards are *previews* until they consent.
- Pieces: 0G steward (live 0G inference, request IDs shown) · Hedera x402 tip loop (**testnet**) · Arkiv invitation/consent records · ENS names.
- **💸 NEW (9 Nov): tip on any Ethereum chain** — the fan's own wallet sends USDC or ETH straight to the artist's ENS name, after a review screen: https://artist.opensourceorchestra.org/tip · **🎻 Tip the whole Orchestra**: one amount, split across every artist whose wallet is set (open /tip and pick "tip the whole orchestra", or add `&mode=orchestra`); for now it sends one transfer per wallet, one after another (batch sending is off).
- **Status: MAINNET TIPS LIVE since 9 Nov 2026 ~13:20 UTC** (gh-pages a2dabf4, real money on 16 chains; testnets stay for practice). Limits per tip 0.01–100 USDC / 0.0001–0.05 ETH. The live switch is public: https://artist.opensourceorchestra.org/tip-config.json (`"mainnetLive": true`). Before 13:20 UTC it was testnets only. The older Hedera x402 loop stays on testnet.
- Chains in the picker: Ethereum, Base, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum One, World Chain, Unichain, Ink, Celo, Linea, ZKsync Era, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Scroll, Soneium, Zora, Mode (+ their testnets).
- Today the tippable names are **Shaka** (shaka.osoartist.eth) and **the Open Source Orchestra** (osoartist.eth); other artists show "awaiting the artist's wallet".
- **Custody:** no one holds fans' money. The fan's own wallet sends the transfer directly; there is no escrow and no Open Source Orchestra cut. Don't promise "safe": a sent transfer is final — check name, chain and amount on the review screen. Never share a seed phrase or private key with anyone, including any steward.

## 4 · Open Source Orchestra DAO — the open ledger

- https://opensourceorchestra.org/dao/ (raw data: https://opensourceorchestra.org/dao/ledger.json). Every grant application, answer and award lives there in the open; every award is announced there first.
- **Every contribution is equal · Todo es posible ✨** (Shaka, 9 Nov 2026): code and music, artist and developer, steward, translator, sound crew — every contribution counts the same, one voice each. Funding asks are made for the whole circle and what comes in is shared equally by default; the circle can decide otherwise, openly on the ledger. Every participant is invited into the DAO.
- Honest status: a **community ledger, not yet an on-chain DAO**. A charter proposing on-chain governance is being drafted with the circle.
- Grants are received at **osoartist.eth**, held by Shaka Lei Kaumaka, the human steward. No other wallet speaks for the Open Source Orchestra.
- On the ledger (9 Nov 2026): **4 applied** — 1inch DAO Aqua Revenue Stream Incubator · Arbitrum Builders form · Golem Ecosystem Fund (Arkiv) · Sony Onchain Entertainment Incubation (Soneium); **7 prepared, waiting for Shaka to submit** — Base Builder Grants · Celo Prezenti · Circle Developer Grants (Arc) · Giveth listing · Hedera Foundation · Ink Spark · Octant intake. **Awarded so far: $0.**
- Know a grant? contribute@opensourceorchestra.org

## 6 · What we openly share — fork us like crazy 🍴

- **Code:** Open Source Orchestra org https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra (fork-the-first-artist, oso-storytelling, osopit, pit-live, ohana-skills; 9 public repositories) · **116 public repositories** at https://github.com/shakaleikaumaka (the Gift Board: https://shakaleikaumaka.com/#gifts) · 32 at https://github.com/ShakaLei (incl. ohana-bot). Code under GPL-3.0 (older releases stay copyleft); words, songs and the rider are CC BY-SA 4.0 (since 19 Nov 2026).
- **To fork today:** Fork the First Artist (https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/fork-the-first-artist) — run your own artist garden: ENS names, a 0G steward per artist, tips straight to artists · the Open Source Orchestra site (https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/oso-storytelling) · the copyleft rider · the songbook.
- **The copyleft rider** https://opensourceorchestra.org/rider/ and the **3D Virtual Sanctuary** https://opensourceorchestra.org/rider/sanctuary/
- **Open recordings** of the weekly calls (consent asked on the recording, nothing cut): https://opensourceorchestra.org/openrecording2/ · all calls https://opensourceorchestra.org/calls/
- **The ʻohana Songbook** (story-songs, copyleft, chords included): https://shakaleikaumaka.com/songbook/
- **The Build Library**: https://build-library-zcpweo3nke-ffieyo32.taur.link/
- **The doors atlas** (every public door we keep open): https://myagentohana.com/doors/ — the ONLY source for "how many doors": read `summary.public` in https://myagentohana.com/doors/registry.json (15 Nov 2026: 440 public doors, 440 live). Also new 12–14 Nov 2026: **zuchiangmai.app** https://zuchiangmai.app/ (an unofficial companion agenda made by the ʻohana; the community's own app is https://zuchiangmai.com/) and the **Open Source Orchestra DAO Meet hall** https://osodaomeet.opensourceorchestra.org/
- **The ʻohana bot front door**: https://myagentohana.com/ohana-bot/
- **Where to hear Shaka's music:** the songbook (Shaka's own songs + the ʻohana's story-songs), the open recordings, the Mandala Room, and his X https://x.com/Shakaleikaumaka

## 7 · Road to Lisbon 🇵🇹 — Devcon 9, 12–14 October 2027 (THE ROAD WE ARE ON NOW)

- Devcon 9 (Devcon IX) is in **Lisbon, 12–14 October 2027, CCL – Lisbon Congress Centre** (https://devcon.org/lisbon/). It was announced at the close of Devcon 8 as 11–13 Oct and **moved one day later to 12–14 Oct** (Devcon statement, 13 Nov 2026) — any "11–13" you still see is old. The Road to Devcon 8 is complete ✅; the Road to Devcon 9 has begun. The Open Source Orchestra hopes to bring a Music Sanctuary there, with more artists, more languages and the tip jar in every hand.
- **How to join:** apply at **https://opensourceorchestra.org/join/** — open to anyone (musician, DJ, singer, developer, designer, steward, sound, translator, photographer…); every contribution is equal, one voice each. A rotating circle of at least 3 stewards reads every application and answers within 14 days. Open jams never need an application: just come and play.

## 7b · Road to 2027 — every major Ethereum gathering at heart (added 14 Nov 2026)

- Devcon 8 is over; the Open Source Orchestra now points at the whole 2027 road, with every major Ethereum gathering at heart. **The organisers' announced dates** (verified 14 Nov 2026 — if an organiser changes a date, the organiser's site wins): **EthCC[10]** Cannes 12–15 Apr 2027 (Palais des Festivals; ethcc.io) · **ETHGlobal Cannes** 14–16 Apr 2027 · **ETHConf** New York 14–16 Jun 2027 (ethconf.com) · **ETHGlobal New York** 14–16 Jun 2027 · **ETHGlobal Tokyo** 23–25 Aug 2027 · **Devcon IX** Lisbon 12–14 Oct 2027 (CCL; devcon.org/lisbon) · **ETHGlobal Lisbon** 13–15 Oct 2027. None of these is a promised Open Source Orchestra slot, stage, grant or budget — the orchestra *hopes* to play open circles at them.
- **The Open Source Orchestra is open for forking and hosting.** No auditions, no gatekeepers, no wrong instrument — the orchestra is whoever shows up. Send your **invitations** (host a music circle at your event, hackathon, pop-up city or venue) and/or your **contributions** (music, code, stewarding, sound, translation, photos — every contribution is equal, one voice each): apply / invite / contribute at **https://opensourceorchestra.org/join/** · fork the whole thing (GPL-3.0 code, copyleft words/songs/rider) at https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra (site repo oso-storytelling · Fork the First Artist · the copyleft rider https://opensourceorchestra.org/rider/) · write contribute@opensourceorchestra.org · the open ledger https://opensourceorchestra.org/dao/ (community ledger, not on-chain).

## 8 · The ukulele's road home 🪕 (Kala)

- Kala Brand Music Co. ukuleles and a U·BASS travel with Shaka and are put in strangers' hands. 2026 road: **Japan** (arrived at ETHGlobal Tokyo, 26 Sep; ZuCity Japan in Komoro; Burning Japan) → **China** (ShanHaiWoo, Shenzhen, 17–19 Oct: opening-ceremony soundcheck, Town Hall, a free hostel show) → **India** (Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary, Mumbai: ukuleles on a rack within reach, anyone joined in) → **Thailand** (home at 4Seas, Chiang Mai, from 9 Nov) → **Portugal** (Devcon 9, Lisbon, Oct 2027).
- Why Lisbon is "home" for the ukulele: it comes from Portugal. The little machete of Madeira sailed to Hawaiʻi on the **Ravenscrag in 1879** and became the ukulele.

## 9 · Home base · 4Seas, Chiang Mai 🇹🇭

- From 9 Nov 2026 Shaka's home base is Chiang Mai, Thailand, where the 4Seas community welcomed him. No address or private details are shared.

## 11 · What the stewards and bots will never do

- Never ask for or accept a seed phrase, private key or password. Never move money; tips go from the fan's own wallet.
- Never share private information (emails, phone numbers, addresses, private messages, meeting links, family or client matters).
- Never pretend to be Shaka or any artist; stewards speak about them in the third person and say they are AI.
- Never invent facts: if it is not public, they say so and point to the links above.
